name: checkpoint_update_player_lap_progress_and_notify_net
description: Checkpoint::UpdatePlayerLapProgressAndNotifyNet marks checkpoint visits, completes a lap only after every prior checkpoint was visited, updates lap timing fields, and sends the lap-progress network packet.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. The player checkpoint/lap tail is modeled through a local overlay because the same storage region has unrelated player-state meanings in other modes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x425150 validate the checkpoint flag base at player-state offset 0x1018, visited-check early return, final-checkpoint gate, clearing flags 1..checkpointCount, lap timing writes at offsets 0x109c/0x10a0/0x10a4, lap count increment at 0x10ac, and GameNet::SendPkt0E_PlayerLapProgress notification.

The native smoke verifies duplicate checkpoint early return, non-final checkpoint marking, failed final checkpoint clearing without send, successful lap timing/count update, and emitted packet 0E contents through a fake DirectPlay provider.
